name: branch_that_joins
description: The payments are worked out for 120 guests (total 36,100, later payments 15,050 each). From the guest count's chip the person opens a branch and says they will get no fewer than 150; the side assistant proposes 150, the person accepts, the branch joins the trunk as a decision, and steps 1 and 2 run again (total 43,000, later payments 18,500 each).
lines: Can I cover the three payments if we invite 120 guests? The wedding is on 12 June 2027. Dinner is 230 a guest, plus 5,000 for extras, 2,000 for the DJ and 1,500 for the bar. The first payment is 6,000, due on 1 November 2026, and it counts toward the total. The second and third payments are each half of what remains, due 30 and 14 days before the wedding.

lines.text: We will get no fewer than 150 guests.
